architectural_finding_1.title: Never classify migrations by file — classify by operation
architectural_finding_1.description: Two scripts classified as DATA_DEPENDENT contained structural DDL required by live code. The file-level classification was correct for the UPDATE operations but wrong for the ALTER TABLE operations in the same file. The correct model splits each file into steps (DDL / backfill / rebuild) and classifies each step independently.
architectural_finding_1.impact: schema_baseline.sql required 2 manual patches and is PROVISIONAL until cleanup PR
